legality_basis: span_source / reference_source / legality_tier are deliberately ABSENT. The 2026-08-15 legality doctrine's either-field rule is resolved by core.legality inside core.driver.run_experiment, and this cell does not fly that harness -- it flies core.flight.FlightRuntime, which never reads those keys. Declaring three keys no code on this path resolves would be dead config, the same defect this fragment's prompt_position_basis avoids elsewhere. The substance is stated and enforced instead: the brief's only source is the corpus's own metadata table, pinned by path and sha256 above and re-hashed on every read; no gold, reference, annotation or external byte can reach it; and core.metadata_brief has no code path through which one could.
task_instruction: The reference material above is a pre-meeting brief for this call, built only from the Earnings-22 corpus's own published metadata row for it: the ticker symbol, the country, the UN region, the major dialect family and the language family. Where a value shows a form in brackets after "normalized:", that is the spelling the measurement compares against. It is reference material ONLY, to help you spell names and terms you actually hear, and to tell you what kind of English to expect. Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any listed word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
instruction_basis: BYTE-IDENTICAL to configs/baseline/e22-kc-e2-brief-whole-prompt.json's. The twin varies the brief's CONTENT and nothing else; an instruction that described the control differently would vary two things at once.
twin_basis: The form twin is ANOTHER CALL's brief, not a neutral-placeholder one. core.class_lists.placebo_of replaces every entry token with a position-chosen filler, which is the right control for a brief of dozens of proper nouns and the WRONG one for a five-line fact table: 'Country: item' does not read as a country, so the placebo would vary the content AND the plausibility of the content at once. The pairing is core.metadata_brief.select_twin_partners: for each roster call, the closest-measuring Earnings-22 call OUTSIDE the ten whose ticker, country, UN region and dialect family ALL differ from the arm's. Outside the ten because a partner inside the roster could state a fact that is true of another roster call; fact-distinct because the first pairing this repository built handed call 4453225 a partner that restated its country, its region and its dialect family verbatim. Materialised as the hash-pinned artifact above rather than recomputed from whatever call set happens to load, so a roster change can never silently re-pair the control.
token_match_precondition: THIS FRAGMENT IS THE UNPADDED TWIN AND IS NOT WHAT FLIES. The owner ruling of 2026-09-06 locks a control to its treatment on the FLIGHT tokenizer, and 'South Africa' and 'United States' do not cost the same number of tokens. Before takeoff the flight agent runs scripts/e22_kc_e2_prompt_fit.py --write-pad-plan against the resident server, commits configs/knowledge/e22-brief-v1/pad-plan-v1.json, and edits exactly two keys here: evidence_source becomes 'e22-metadata-brief-deranged-token-matched' and an evidence_brief_pad_plan pin is added. THE ARM'S FRAGMENT TAKES THE SAME TWO-KEY EDIT, to 'e22-metadata-brief-token-matched' and the same pad-plan pin, because the padder is SYMMETRIC here (core.metadata_brief.pair_pad_repeats): a real Earnings-22 brief can be longer than the one it twins, and on the two Oceania calls -- whose briefs are the corpus's shortest, 'Oceania' being the only one-word UN region -- every fact-distinct partner is. What the arm gains is 1 to 3 neutral ' item' repeats per line under the model-free whitespace measurement and no fact of any kind. Both edits move only their own cell's composed config hash. Until they land, this fragment renders a whitespace-shaped twin whose flight-token count is UNMEASURED, and no verdict may be drawn from it.
external_sources: NONE. Owner ruling 2026-09-07, inherited verbatim from the arm: Earnings-22 collects no external information.
scorer_basis: Identical to the arm's, so the two cells are scored by the same four scorers over the same reference layer through the same core.scoring_batch path.
obs_basis: Identical to the arm's: no OBS loop, no windowing, one contact per sample under policy 'fixed'.
why_a_separate_baseline_fragment: Each cell's composed config_hash -- and therefore its protocol_hash and its exposure row -- must be movable only by an edit to ITS OWN fragments.
